No writing or uniform numbers.

Show one clear racket, one nearby ball and the net. A natural easy stance with both arms visible; keep the human rendering and family identity exactly like the references. No extra people.
scenes.swimming: SWIMMING. His own mother from the Family reference is immediately beside him in a modest sage-green swimming top, supporting his torso naturally with both hands. scenes.running: RUNNING. The same boy in a pale blue cotton shirt, tan shorts and comfortable shoes runs along a curved meadow path beside a little wooden footbridge. Full body visible, natural joints and balanced anatomy, gentle happy face looking along the path. No race numbers, speed marks, extra people or animals.
scenes.cycling: CYCLING. The same boy in a pale blue cotton shirt, tan shorts, comfortable shoes and a correctly fitted muted-blue bicycle helmet rides a small blue bicycle with training wheels along a flat tree-lined park path. Both hands naturally hold the handlebars and both feet are on the pedals. Two main wheels, clear stabilizers and a calm stable pose. Full boy and bicycle visible; no cars, traffic, logos or written markings.
scenes.beach: One peaceful sandy beach curving beside a calm turquoise sea, a broad band of golden sand clearly distinct from the water, gentle foamy shoreline and a few soft coastal grasses. No people, buildings or objects competing with the beach itself. Bright gentle morning.
scenes.sandcastle: One large simple sandcastle with two rounded towers and a central arch, freshly built and sitting firmly in damp sand well above the gentle shoreline. One small wooden sand spade resting beside it. No flags, text or people. The sandcastle is unmistakable and fills half the scene.
scenes.seashell: One large rounded scallop seashell with soft cream and pale peach ridges resting naturally on damp beach sand beside a tiny shallow tide pool. Shell is closed or empty, no creature or face. Calm blue sea softly behind. Seashell is the clear large focal subject.
scenes.wave: One gentle curling turquoise sea wave with a clear rounded crest and soft white foam rolling onto a sandy shore. The wave fills the middle of the scene and visibly meets the beach, not a floating isolated shape. A little wet sand and peaceful horizon. No people or objects.
scenes.bucket: One simple blue child's beach bucket with a curved handle, sitting upright on sandy beach with a little damp sand inside and a small wooden spade resting on the sand beside it. Calm sea softly beyond. Bucket large and easy to recognize, no logos or faces.
scenes.beach_umbrella: One large open blue-and-cream beach umbrella with its pole firmly planted in sand, visibly casting a cool shaded patch on a folded beach towel. Gentle sunlit beach and calm sea behind. Umbrella is the clear main subject. No people, letters, logos or markings.
scenes.wind: A small leafy garden tree gently bending in a steady breeze, several loose autumn leaves visibly blowing together through the air and a plain blue scarf on a nearby clothesline streaming in the same direction. These physical effects clearly explain wind without drawn arrows or motion symbols. Calm weather, no storm or damage.
scenes.snow: Soft white snowflakes gently falling and visibly settling on a rounded garden bush, a low fence and the ground. The snow is clearly distinct against a soft blue-green winter background. Peaceful winter scene with no people, symbols or scary weather.
scenes.rainbow: One clear soft seven-color rainbow arching across a pale blue sky above a freshly watered green meadow, with a small receding rain cloud at one side and gentle warm sunshine at the other. Wet leaves glisten below, explaining the relationship between sun, rain and rainbow. No face on sun or cloud.
scenes.hot: HOT. The same boy in a light pale-blue cotton shirt and tan shorts sits safely in the shade of an orchard tree during a bright hot summer afternoon. His cheeks are slightly flushed, two small beads of perspiration at the temple, and one hand fans his face with a plain straw handheld fan. A clear cup of cool water rests on a low stone within reach. Strong warm sunshine beyond the shade and physical cooling action make feeling hot immediately understandable. Comfortable and safe, with a small calm expression rather than a big cartoon smile. Full seated body visible.
scenes.cold: COLD. The same boy outdoors on a softly snowy cottage path, wearing a muted-blue winter coat, sage scarf, mittens and sturdy boots. He gently hugs his arms close to his chest with shoulders slightly tucked, and a small visible puff of breath leaves his lips in the cold air. Snow and a frosted garden gate clearly explain the cold. Mildly chilly but safe and calm; natural face and proportions, not distress. Full body visible.
scenes.wet: WET. The same boy in a plain muted-blue raincoat and olive boots stands just under a garden porch after gentle rain. Large realistic droplets cling to the coat, damp hair tips and cuffs drip into a small puddle directly below. He looks down at his wet sleeve and lightly touches it with the other hand. Gentle rain outside the porch and physical moisture make wetness obvious. No drawn droplet icons or floating symbols. Natural full-body pose.
scenes.dry: DRY. The same boy now completely dry, in a pale-blue cotton shirt and tan trousers, sits on a low bathroom bench with a fluffy cream towel draped over his shoulders, holding its edges. His sandy wavy hair is soft and dry, skin and clothing visibly dry, feet rest on a dry cream bath mat. A nearby window shows lingering rain outdoors, but everything around him indoors is dry and cozy. Fully clothed, calm subtle smile, natural anatomy. No puddles or artificial symbols.
scenes.hungry: HUNGRY. The same boy sits at the family's simple kitchen table, one hand resting gently on his tummy, looking expectantly at a sandwich on a plate being set down directly on the table by his mother. Show his own mother from the Family reference naturally beside the table, her chestnut hair and cream floral blouse with sage cardigan recognizable; the plate is supported by her hand and table, never floating. The child has an expectant gentle face and slight open mouth, no tears or distress. One clear relationship between tummy, hunger and arriving food.
scenes.thirsty: THIRSTY. The same boy in a pale-blue cotton shirt and tan shorts sits on a shady park bench after play and takes a drink from a clear cup of water held naturally in both hands. The rim meets his lips, and the water level is visible through the cup. Gentle warm sunlight falls on the path beyond the shade. The drinking action clearly communicates thirst. Full seated body, no food or other competing objects, realistic young-child proportions.
scenes.tired: TIRED. The same boy in soft pale-blue pajamas sits on the edge of a low wooden bed in gentle dusk light, eyes naturally half closed, one hand politely covering a small yawn and shoulders relaxed. Feet rest near the floor, a green blanket and small teddy sit on the bed. A quiet evening sky is visible through the bedroom window. Clear sleepy expression and body language, mild and soothing. Same naturalistic Family/Body Parts face, no huge cartoon mouth.
scenes.rested: RESTED. The same boy in the same soft pale-blue pajamas sits upright on his low bed after a good night's sleep, stretching both arms gently upward with relaxed open hands, bright calm eyes and a subtle refreshed smile. The same green blanket lies over the bed and gentle morning light enters the window. Clearly refreshed and rested; natural stretching anatomy, five fingers on each visible hand. No alarm clock, written marks or artificial sparkle symbols.
scenes.happy: HAPPY. The same boy in a pale-blue cotton shirt and tan trousers sits comfortably on a garden picnic blanket, looking with a clear gentle joyful expression at one soap bubble floating near his outstretched hand. Natural warm smile, lifted cheeks, bright kind eyes and open relaxed posture; no oversized animation eyes or exaggerated teeth. A few softly painted daisies and grasses remain secondary. Full seated body, recognizable same family child.
scenes.sad: SAD. The same boy in a pale-blue cotton shirt and tan trousers sits on a wooden garden bench holding a little wooden toy sailboat; its small mast has come loose and rests on the bench beside him. His eyes look down with one small tear, softly downturned lips and slightly lowered shoulders: understandable mild sadness. His own mother from Family kneels naturally next to the bench, same chestnut hair, cream floral blouse and sage cardigan, her reassuring hand resting on his shoulder. Both faces visible and naturally proportioned. Comforting calm scene, never frightening or extreme distress.
